answer: Operator-Linked Reputation Ledger. Each agent wallet maps to a verified operator record; a sybil cluster detected by shared funding or behavior creates a ripple across all wallets under that operator. Enforcement freezes the operator's entire ledger, not just the flagged wallet. A plume of collateral held at the operator level is slashed proportional to cluster size. Because identity cost scales with the operator's full portfolio, an attacker must expose a basalt-heavy treasury per fake identity—concrete cost: one operator bond covering every wallet, forfeited on detection.
